candidate.title: PAT-ChIP
candidate.scope: The single PAT-ChIP (pathology tissue chromatin immunoprecipitation) row of the supplied Illumina poster crop: an FFPE-derived chromatin extraction and antibody-selection route ending in purified DNA. The left yellow-wrapped nucleosome motif and method expansion identify the assay; the explicit FFPE-fixed chromatin icon starts its process route. Adjacent Nucleo-Seq, FiT-seq and X-ChIP rows are separately labeled contextual workflows, with no connecting arrows or depicted alternatives for PAT-ChIP. Library construction and sequencing are outside the drawn route. This schematic-level architecture is supported by the Fanelli PAT-ChIP protocol abstract and the verified PAT-ChIP secondary catalogue page, without claiming that all related fixed-tissue assays share the same implementation.

operations.label: MNase digestion
operations.description: Digest DNA in the deparaffinated, rehydrated chromatin with MNase, yielding fragmented chromatin that is then routed to sonication.
operations.mechanism: MNase-mediated nuclease digestion; orange symbols accompany the chromatin at this named step and are treated as reagent/enzyme icons, not a separate material branch.
operations.information_effect: Produces chromatin fragments for downstream extraction and antibody selection. The drawing does not establish a protected-footprint readout, a precise digestion endpoint or perfect target specificity.

operations.label: Sonicate
operations.description: Apply sonication to the MNase-digested FFPE-derived chromatin to produce the depicted soluble chromatin extract.
operations.mechanism: Physical shearing/solubilization by sonication, as summarized by the arrow to Soluble extract.
operations.information_effect: Makes chromatin fragments available for immunoprecipitation. The secondary catalogue flags possible sonication-related sequence bias; this is a limitation on representation, not a measured PAT-ChIP-specific bias in this diagram.

operations.label: Immunoprecipitate and chromatin elution
operations.description: Use the depicted antibody interaction to select chromatin from the soluble extract, then elute the selected chromatin. Both actions remain one block at the resolution of the source caption.
operations.mechanism: Antibody-based chromatin immunoprecipitation followed by chromatin elution; the diagram does not identify an antibody epitope or capture-support chemistry.
operations.information_effect: Enriches DNA physically associated with the antibody-recognized chromatin target. The primary abstract identifies histone modifications and transcription-factor binding as intended PAT-ChIP targets. Enrichment is not proof that every recovered fragment contains the intended target.

operations.label: Reverse crosslink and proteinase K digestion

The candidate distinguishes diagram/corroborating catalogue order from abstract-only primary support and asserts neither implementation interchangeability nor historical priority. No consequential source conflict requiring a correction was identified in the inspected evidence; unavailable full protocol text has not been treated as verified. The generic antibody specificity is appropriately nonblocking.
